summary.text: Doug Lee is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 80, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Lily Cheng-Schulting.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Lee described himself as a business owner who owns Jam'nBean Coffee & Tea Company in the Grand Rapids area.

paragraphs.text: Doug Lee graduated from Millington High School.
In the survey he said he has more than 40 years of experience in business operations and is also associated with Taro Systems, Inc., a software company serving the real estate industry.
Lee said he became actively involved in local education issues in 2020, regularly attending school board meetings.
Lee said his campaign focuses on improving public education, increasing accountability in government spending and strengthening workforce readiness.
He said he has raised concerns about the use of special elections for school millages and bonds, and that he supports expanded vocational and technical training.
